_comment: [OPUS-4.8] Per-member ZK circuit cost + semantics table for the website ZK-benchmark page. gate_count values are the DETERMINISTIC committed snapshot (crates/sparq-zk-compose/tests/gate_count_snapshot.json, `bb gates -s ultra_honk` circuit_size, bb 5.0.0-nightly.20260324, nargo 1.0.0-beta.21). prove_ms_t1 / prove_ms_tN are INDICATIVE / NON-CANONICAL (native `bb prove` on a shared EC2 work box, wall-clock incl. process startup + CRS/SRS load) and are populated ONLY for filter_int_d2 (the live browser circuit) where a measurement exists; null everywhere else (NOT fabricated). proof/vk size and verify time are CONSTANT across the family (ultra_honk succinctness) and are NOT per-member fields here. STANDING CAVEAT: the composition verifier is NOT-yet-sound (sq-qhy4 / sq-9hrn / sq-1s2); the estate is research-grade, internally reviewed only, NOT externally audited; the separate MPC layer is semi-honest. A passing/fast proof is NOT a soundness or privacy guarantee under an adversarial prover.
timing_caveat: prove_ms_* are INDICATIVE / NON-CANONICAL native bb prove wall-clock on a shared EC2 box (includes process startup + CRS/SRS load); populated only where measured; null = unmeasured (not fabricated). Verify time, proof bytes and vk bytes are constant across the family and are not per-member fields.
soundness_caveat: Composition verifier NOT-yet-sound (sq-qhy4/sq-9hrn/sq-1s2). Research-grade, NOT externally audited. MPC layer (separate) is semi-honest. A 'verified' result is not production-trustworthy.

constant_family_costs.note: proof/vk size and verify time are constant across the whole family (ultra_honk). evm/keccak flavour proof is smaller and still zero-knowledge (disableZk:false).

members.source: snapshot=24452 (sq-z9l baseline 16932 + the sq-ru0yx M-1 challenge-reduction no-wrap bound +14 ACIR gates = 16946, + the sq-l15mi prime-order-subgroup guards on pk and R, +7506). FOUR ~251-bit twisted-Edwards scalar muls now dominate — s*G and e*pk for the verification equation, plus the two [L]*P torsion-key checks the sq-l15mi soundness fix added (explicit Field constraints; embedded_curve_* is Grumpkin/wrong curve). Heaviest non-scan/non-filter operator. ADDITIVE only — clear-key attestation still mandatory.

The manifest verify seam for the hidden-key tier is DEFERRED; the LANDED holder binding wired into verify_manifest is the clear-key B1 tier that discloses hpk.
